div.span: Closing the window destroys it (a hidden WebKit view can come back blank); the tray and the agent stay. Opening builds a fresh window from the saved configuration. With no tray (some Linux desktops) closing quits. Quitting the app never stops the agent (ADR 0001, 0009; docs/suite-lessons.md).

div.span: Every backend request has a timeout and an inline error with Retry; initialisers start work in the background and return, so a reopened window is never blank for good. The agent keeps sampling and keeps rules applied after the app exits.
